rows.corpus_definition: To find something or meet someone by chance.
rows.example_en: I did come across an old photo today.

rows.corpus_definition: to do something wrong or against the law.
rows.example_en: People should not commit any crimes.

rows.corpus_definition: The act of sharing thoughts or news with others.
rows.example_en: Good communication is important in a team.

rows.corpus_definition: The act of sharing thoughts or facts with others.
rows.example_en: Good communication is important at work.

rows.corpus_definition: Used to judge how two things are different or similar.
rows.example_en: This is a comparative study of two different education systems.

rows.corpus_definition: to give something to make up for a loss or problem
rows.example_en: The company agreed to compensate her for the damaged goods.

rows.corpus_definition: To make something harder to understand or do.
rows.example_en: Do not complicate the simple plan.

rows.corpus_definition: Kind words said to someone to show you like something.
rows.example_en: She gave me a nice compliment on my dress.

rows.corpus_definition: a person who writes musical pieces.
rows.example_en: The composer wrote a lovely new symphony.

rows.corpus_definition: a piece of writing or music created by someone.
rows.example_en: She finished her school composition last night.
The basic concept is easy to understand.
